item.title: Sharon Osbourne Marks First Wedding Anniversary Without Ozzy: ‘Forever My Heart’
item.description:
[Energetic music fades out, and the host begins speaking]
Host: "Welcome to Trending on Billboard! Today, we're taking a moment to remember a rock legend. Sharon Osbourne recently marked what would have been her 46th wedding anniversary with the late Ozzy Osbourne. She shared a beautiful tribute on Instagram, celebrating a love that endures even in death.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: "Ozzy passed away on July 22, 2025, at the age of 76, after a public battle with Parkinson's disease. But his legacy lives on. Did you know that after his passing, his music saw a significant surge on the Billboard charts? His classic track 'Crazy Train' hit the Billboard Hot 100 for the first time, debuting at number 46, and 'Mama, I'm Coming Home' re-entered the chart after 33 years.
[Music transitions to a more upbeat tone]
Host: "Ozzy's compilation, The Essential Ozzy Osbourne, reached new heights, peaking at number 7 on the Billboard 200 and topping multiple rock charts. And, fun fact: the top seven positions on the Hot Hard Rock Songs chart were entirely filled with Osbourne and Black Sabbath tracks.
[Music fades out, and the host speaks]
Host: "Throughout his career, Ozzy sold over 100 million albums worldwide, with nine solo top 10 entries on the Billboard 200 and two top 10 Hot 100 hits. He left an unforgettable mark on the music world. Join us in remembering this rock icon and the incredible music he left behind."
[Closing music plays, and the host says]
Host: "Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll catch you on the next episode!" [Music fades out]
